# Cncf Kubereport Reviewer

Review KubeReport using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Observability category. KubeReport is an open-source tool that generates detailed Kubernetes cluster reports in PDF and CSV formats, providing insights into  resource utilization, workload status, and cluster health for easier auditing and troubleshooting.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
